docs.title: ▪ About Me
docs.text: I am a passionate Water Resources Engineer and Researcher with a strong focus on applying Data Science and Machine Learning to environmental and hydrological challenges. With an M.Sc. from Sharif University of Technology and a background in Civil Engineering, I aim to bridge the gap between traditional hydrological modeling and advanced data-driven predictive frameworks.

docs.title: ▪ Research Interests
docs.text:
• Modeling and Forecasting: Hydrological and Water Quality Processes
  • Environmental Systems: Sensitivity Analysis and Model Optimization
  • Data-Driven Approaches: Machine Learning, Ensemble Learning, and Deep Learning applications in water resources

docs.title: Research Experience
docs.text:
Graduate Research Assistant | Sharif University of Technology (2024 – Present) - Collecting, monitoring, and analyzing channel data to develop robust ensemble machine learning models for predicting odor pollution in urban waterways.

Research Assistant | Sharif University of Technology (2021 – 2023) - Applied machine learning models to compare traditional and novel sensitivity analysis methods on hydrological models.

Data Scientist | Novel Construction Technology R&D Center (TECNOSA) (2019 – 2021) - Engineered an end-to-end predictive pipeline using machine learning models to forecast construction equipment productivity from daily report data.

docs.title: Professional Experience
docs.text:
Hydrology & Hydraulic Engineer | POLROOD Consulting Engineer (2024 – Present) - Developed automated tools for hydrological modeling and infrastructure design using Python and GIS-based platforms (Roadway & Railway Department).

Water Engineer | ABVARZAN Consulting Engineer (2023 – 2024) - Developed a project control system for schedule and cost management (Water Department).

docs.title: Academic & Research Projects
docs.text:
Below is a selection of my key academic projects combining water resources engineering and data-driven modeling:

  • River-Lake Systems Modeling: Assessment of Physical Models (Qual2kw) and Machine Learning for River-Lake Systems.
  • Open Channel Flow Hydraulics: Developing a Numerical Method in Open Channel Flow Hydraulic with Python.
  • Water Quality Modeling: Temperature and Salinity Modeling Using CE-QUAL-W2.
  • Global Sensitivity Analysis: Signature-based Global Sensitivity Analysis of the HBV Model Using Sobol and RSA Methods.
  • Groundwater Modeling: Groundwater Projects with PMWIN & GMS Models.
